name: CRT_rand
notes: MT CRT rand: ptd+0x14 = ptd+0x14*214013+2531011; returns (state>>16)&0x7FFF. Initial state 1. Ported game::CrtRand::Next

name: CRT_srand
notes: Sets ptd+0x14 = seed. Only caller 0x004ABE70

name: CRT_rand_thunk
notes: jmp 0x004ADED2; all 538 game rand call sites call this (notes/agents/effects_rand_sites.csv)

name: CRT_srand_wrapper
notes: push arg; call 0x004ADEC5; only caller Game_SeedRandom

name: Game_SeedRandom
notes: srand(Game_IsDemoMode() ? 0 : *(u32*)0x009A32A0). Callers: stage start 0x00460030, event op 0x4D 0x0045EEC0. Confirmed: reseeds to 0 at demo frames 2786/2788

name: Evt_Op4D_StageReset
notes: Opcode 0x4D (4 bytes): camera/state reset, then Game_SeedRandom (in mode 5 only if 0x009A26A4 == 0, then sets it); 0x009C71C4 (demo input) = (mode == 5)

name: Evt_Op1B_SetSkyType
notes: Opcode 0x1B (8 bytes): 0x009A2C34 = arg (sky table index). Stage-1 demo: 4

name: Evt_Op1C_SetSkyMode
notes: Opcode 0x1C: 0x009CA090 = arg (0 hidden, 1 rotate, 2 frozen)

name: Evt_Op1D_SetRain
notes: Opcode 0x1D: rain flag 0x009C8E50 = arg

name: Stage_Start
notes: Clears 0x009A26A4, Game_SeedRandom, resource setup, Task_ResetAll(0x00460710), Stage_ResetState. Runs at demo frame 2786

name: Stage_InitTasks
notes: Task init callback of Stage_Start: Sky_Create 0x0046071F, Rain_Init 0x00460742, ...

name: Stage_ResetState
notes: Clears per-stage globals incl. sky mode 0x009CA090 and rain flag 0x009C8E50

name: Rain_Init
notes: Creates Rain_Task (0x58 bytes); pool 0x007C1EB8 (50 x {x,y,z}) = (rand%20-10, rand%50-25, rand%25-35); clears rain flag. Ported game::Rain::Init

name: Rain_Task
notes: If 0x009C8E50==1: per particle y-=2, respawn (3 rand) if y<=-7; world = p*Ry(camYaw)+camPos; draw model 0x53 with S(1.5,3.5,1)*Rz(0x100)*Ry(face)*T. Verified 25600/25600 draws. Ported game::Rain::Update

name: Sky_Task
notes: Table 0x00579968[type]; yaw +0x48 reset to yawInit on type change, += step unless mode 2; S(1.2,1.2,-1.2)*Ry(yaw)*T(cam+(0,yOff,0)); type 5 Ry(-yaw)*Rz(0x8000). Verified 1024/1024 draws. Ported game::Sky

name: Sky_Create
notes: Creates Sky_Task (0x58 bytes, +0x48 NOT initialised); sky mode=1, type=prevType=0 (so the first type-0 frames keep the uninitialised yaw: title sky)

name: Sky_DrawPanelA
notes: Type 10: screen-fixed sky panel (identity; T(0

name: Sky_DrawPanelB
notes: Types 8/11: identity; T(0

name: Sky_AnimatePanel
notes: Walks the sky model's chunks (task +0x50 toggle); not traced

name: Eff_Task
notes: Billboard effect (0x68 bytes): S*Rz(+0x4C)*Rx(+0x44)*Ry(+0x48)*T(+0x38); draws model +0x60 then ++, dies when > +0x64 or +0x5D&2. Verified 90/90 draws. Ported game::BillboardEffect::Step

name: Eff_Spawn
notes: params: pos[3], pitch, yaw, ?, scale[3] (-1 = default), type, faceMode. Type switch -> model range/scale/roll (0x53: roll = rand()%0xFFFF; 0x5A also spawns 0x5C,0x5D); distance rule on view z. Ported game::BillboardEffect::Spawn

name: Eff_SpawnAt
signature: void __cdecl (float* posAngles6, int type, int faceMode, int arg4)
notes: Builds the Eff_Spawn block with scale -1; 40 callers (e.g. 0x00433AE8 type 0x62, enemies 0x0045xxxx type 0x61)

name: Eff_SpawnBlock
notes: Calls Eff_Spawn with a caller-built block (5 callers)

name: Eff_SpawnScaled
notes: Types 0x5A-0x5D, faces camera; scale *= viewZ*-1/30 when viewZ > -30 (min 0.25). Callers 0x00407C7A.., 0x0049161C

name: Eff_PlaySound
notes: Snd_PlayGameSound per type (0x61/0x62: 0xC16A9). Ported game::EffectSound

name: Obj_SplashOnce
notes: One-shot task that spawns effect 0x62 (faceMode 1) at 0x00433AE8 and dies (demo frame 2830)

name: Player_DemoInput
notes: Attract-demo fake gun when 0x009C71C4==1: rand%60 < (0x009C7006 ? 6 : 1) fires; aim (rand%150*2-150, rand%100*2-100). Verified 520/520 frames. Ported game::PlayerDemoInput

name: Player_Task
notes: Per-player task (task +0x34 = player index, records 0x009A5C60+i*0x130); calls 0x00414940/0x00414B90 (input), draws shot flash models 373-381/2934-2942 (P1), 383-391/2948-2956 (P2)

name: Player_UpdateDemoInput
notes: Calls Player_DemoInput then shot handling; mode-dependent branch 0x00414B90

name: Task_Run
notes: Recursive: children list +0x28 first, then own fn (setjmp 0x007DF838), then list +0x24. Root 0x007DF878; current 0x007DF8B0

name: Task_RunFrom
notes: Sets current = task and runs Task_Run

name: Task_KillSelf
notes: Unlinks the current task, frees it to list 0x007DF8AC, longjmps back to the scheduler

name: Task_ResetAll
notes: Frees the task tree (0x004A7120) and calls init

name: Task_FreeTree
notes: Recursive unlink of the current task's subtree

name: Task_ClearBody
notes: Zeroes the task from +0x34 to its allocation size (header -0x10)

name: Mtx_TransformPoint
notes: out = (in.xyz 1) * current stack matrix (rows 0-3)

name: Mtx_LoadIdentity
notes: Copies identity 0x00571210 to the stack top

name: Mtx_Scale
signature: void __cdecl (float x, float y, float z)
notes: Scales rows 0/1/2 of the stack top (pre-multiply by diag)

name: Mtx_Load
notes: Copies m to the stack top

name: Mdl_DrawQueued
notes: Like 0x00418560 but via 0x004AA350, which stores param in queue word 4 (rain: 0.5)

name: Mdl_SubmitParam
notes: Builds a draw record (matrix + light state) and calls 0x004A8390 with param

name: Mdl_SetDrawFlags
notes: 0x007E78BC = flags & 0xF (ORed into queued draw records by 0x004A8390); effects use 0xE then restore 8

name: Math_Max3
signature: float __cdecl (float a, float b, float c)
notes: Result passed to Debug_Nop (unused)

name: Game_PickTargetPlayer
notes: 0x009C7000==2: rand&1 picks player for 0x009C8908/0x009C890C (demo: 7 calls, on shots)

name: Snd_PlayEnemyHitVoice
notes: rand%5 voice table 0x00577674, rand&1 variants; called by enemy code

name: Enemy_PickMotionVariant
notes: Motion ids 0x1DF/0x3D9-0x3E0/0x3F7/0x3F8/0x404/0x41A: rand%17>>4 (1 in 17) picks the alternative (demo: 238 calls)

name: Enemy_PickTargetPlayer
notes: rand&1 when both players are active (demo: once per enemy spawn)

name: Rain_Pool
notes: Camera-relative rain particles

name: Rain_Enabled
notes: Set by event op 0x1D; cleared by Rain_Init / Stage_ResetState

name: Sky_Type
notes: Event op 0x1B

name: Sky_Mode
notes: Event op 0x1C; Sky_Create sets 1

name: Sky_PrevType
notes: Type seen by the previous Sky_Task run

name: Sky_Table
signature: struct {s16 model, model2; f32 yOffset; s32 yawStep, yawInit;}[12]
notes: Ported game::LoadSkyTable

name: Demo_InputEnabled
notes: Set by op 0x4D when mode == 5

name: Demo_Busy
notes: Raises the demo fire chance from 1/60 to 6/60 (set while enemies are active?)

name: Game_FrameCounter
notes: Seed for Game_SeedRandom outside demo modes; written by 0x0049F4AA and 0x0040AA02
